source_evidence.evidence: The v0.91.8 activation map names #4762 as the source for Birth witnesses/receipt with required evidence of an auditable receipt package.
#4762 remains one of the identity and birthday documentation owners consumed by WP-21 #5362.
The launch packet requires witness set and citizen-facing receipt, while explicitly denying that planning surfaces prove the birthday happened.
The feature contract requires memory grounding, capability envelope, witness set, and receipt surfaces without exposing raw private state.
The birthday feature requires deterministic rejection of startup, wake, snapshot, admission, copied state, and missing evidence cases.

witnesses.attestation: The package can witness identity and continuity only by reference to retained source evidence; it does not create an identity root or continuity head.
Memory grounding and capability evidence must be redaction-safe references plus provider, model, tool, skill, authority, and limit context.
The retained negative-case register rejects lifecycle events and missing evidence as birth, instead of treating them as deferred success.
The v0.91.8 handoff and activation surfaces can cite this package by exact path for WP-21 #5362 and v0.92 WP-09 consumption.

redaction_policy.allowed_memory_surface: redaction-safe references and witnessed projections only
redaction_policy.allowed_capability_surface: declared provider, model, tool, skill, authority, and limit context
redaction_policy.reviewer_packet: public paths, non-secret evidence summaries, and explicit blockers
